structure: search on supplied event records: a model-agnostic localized-excess search against a declared smooth background
prompt: Search the supplied ntuple for a localized excess over a declared smooth background with a model-agnostic method. Deliver an excess figure and an internal note; retain failed and inconclusive evidence.

quantity.meaning: Synthetic local excess in units of the background-only spread; not a discovery claim.

method:
def local_excess(observed, expected, spread):
    return (observed - expected) / spread

hypotheses.citation_led: An excess is localized in one window of the supplied observable.
hypotheses.speculative: The supplied records agree with the smooth background everywhere.
